stages.headline: The volume of a cone is V = ⅓ πr²h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a cone is V = ⅓ πr²h.

stages.headline: Example: r = 3, h = 4 give V = ⅓ π · 9 · 4 = 12π.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: r = 3, h = 4 give V = ⅓ π · 9 · 4 = 12π.

stages.headline: A cone has one third of the volume of the cylinder with the same base and height.
